_about: Methyl myristate (1) + n-Hexadecane (2): isobaric T-x-y at 5.0 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of methyl myristate, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of methyl myristate, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: H. Li, H. Luo, S. Xia, P. Ma, Isobaric vapor-liquid equilibrium for the three binary systems of C14 - C16 n-alkane + methyl myristate at 5.00 kPa, Fluid Phase Equilib. 408 (2016) 47-51
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 5, 6. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0042. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.15 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
